title: Blind pair studies: which hit is bigger?
detail: 3 rounds, 77 pairs. Old strength (v1 redirection) matched the owner on 31/63 decisive pairs, whole-body motion change on 46/63 (pairs chosen where the measures disagree; head to head 22 : 7). Spin: 8 : 3, weak support.

title: line.strike.v2: strength = whole-body motion change (travel + spin) in 50 ms
detail: Proven equal to the judged research measure (1e-9). Compiler under v2: v2 loss 0.078 → 0.037; completion and timing unchanged.

title: line.strike.v3: floor-then-rail opposite pushes are two impacts
detail: 94% of added splits start on an opposite-facing surface; July (no rails) has none. Double impacts per beat −0.13 / −0.16. Speed rms +0.007 (authored only): an explicit, logged exception.

title: Catch turn seeded in 2 frames (H-1a)
detail: Null.

title: Impact weight 2 (H-1b)
detail: Strong bias +0.02, but speed rms +0.026.

title: Survival envelope
detail: Survival depends on how the rider meets the floor: at 45° the rider crashes above about 0.9, but a near-vertical drop onto flat ground survives even 1.0. The first coarse grid wrongly implied 0.9 was the ceiling; the code review caught it.

title: Release reserve 3 frames (L6)
detail: Null; contested +0.7 pp.

title: L1: steep, ask-driven arrival before strong beats
detail: Strong bias +0.020 / +0.024, speed rms −0.014 / −0.022, contested +1 pp. Confirmed on fresh seeds.

title: L1 at weight 1; thresholds 0.4 and 0.75
detail: Weight 0.3 and threshold 0.6 are bracketed.

title: Strong hits are mostly sled-tip strikes plus spin
detail: Median sled-to-surface angle 39° at strong hits; strength barely depends on speed into the surface. Quiet overshoot comes from sled pitch too.

title: L9: lookahead ×1.3 into strong beats
detail: Strong bias +0.009, contested −0.8 pp, +0.32M frames. ×1.6 gave a similar gain at 5× the compile time.

title: Agent B: sharper catch turn; energy audit
detail: Catches are already sharp; sharper ones crash (42–81%). Passages are not energy-bound. Arrival-speed headroom helped only before L1.

title: Agent A: pose-matched catches, guided dive
detail: Nothing beyond L1. A slam at an angle costs speed (tan(i/2) per unit of impact), which the spec charges for; sharper turns crash. Past L1 this is a frontier.

title: Search aims at most 0.85 (unreachable requests)
detail: Strength fell; no guard improved.

title: Fresh-seed confirmation of L1 + L9
detail: Strong bias +0.031 / +0.023, speed rms −0.025 / −0.023, other guards neutral.

title: Learned models: without value model / policies; more policy samples
detail: Both models still help under v3 (no policies: completion −12.5 pp); more samples null.

title: Scorecard blind-spot audit
detail: L1 had raised head-down or backward strong arrivals 24% → 31% (July 13%), invisible to the scorecard. Three guard rows added.

title: Upright steep arrival
detail: Head-down or backward strong arrivals 30% → 15% (about 22% → 15% against the evening), body drag −0.14 s/min, impact unchanged. Judged by the same geometric test as the penalty; needs the owner's look.

title: Calm impact multiplier 3 / 2.2; upright weight 2
detail: Quiet beats improve only at the expense of very strong beats; weight 2 costs air.

title: Agent C: why 'L'amour de ma vie' is hard
detail: The spec asks near a momentum limit (back-to-back ≥ 0.9 hits about 13 frames apart); intro speed targets unreachable; not budget-bound (1.5× allowance: no gain).

title: Native whole-body read
detail: Compile 75 s → 60 s per ride, byte-identical (parity on all 63 cells).

title: Pressing rail for dense strong runs
detail: A roof that forces the descent breaks the sled–body binding or removes the hit. In dense runs, descent refills each hit's speed bill almost exactly. A gravity-ride continuation was null on the panel.

title: Code review of tonight's changes
detail: No correctness bug in product code. Corrected: spin evidence (8 : 3, not 12 : 4), v1/v2 compile modes back on the evening profile, upright judged by its own test, the survival ceiling (1.0 survives a near-vertical drop), plus tool-safety fixes and tests.

title: Learned models retrained under v3 on data disjoint from the eval songs
detail: The V6-era artifacts were trained partly on the evaluation songs. Rebuilt construction policies: impact loss −0.007, strong bias +0.015, air −0.005 on all four panels; body drag +30% (explicit exception). The value-model retrain was no better (old, retrained, constant and none are within 0.01), so it is not adopted.
